name: Ice Knife

components.m: a drop of water or a piece of ice

targets.description: one creature; the burst also hits each creature within 5 feet of it

summary: Ranged spell attack for 1d10 Piercing; the shard then bursts for 2d6 Cold (Dexterity save) within 5 feet.
text: Make a ranged spell attack against one creature within range; on a hit it takes 1d10 Piercing damage. Hit or miss, the shard then bursts: the target and every creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 2d6 Cold damage (no damage on a success). Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: the Cold damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 1.
